decision: SHELVE this standalone ALK-scaffold response proposal; no useful new finding survives.
actually_measured: Four source-reported NCC IC50s and six source-reported screen means/SD retained literally; two separate USZ20 ordinals.
actually_calculated: Fixed source IC50/brigatinib ratios and screening mean-minus-brigatinib differences, descriptive only. These are new arithmetic observations of old measurements, not new experiments.
validity: Source fields and CAS crosswalks are reproducible. Original plan copied wrong crizotinib IC50 CAS; pre-output KeyError and additive source-label-only correction preserved. Negative normalized screening mean retained; no clipping. No salts/enantiomers collapsed.
value: Reported IC50 contrast remains brigatinib-centered, matching authors existing compound prioritization. It supplies no demonstrated new model/drug-choice consequence. Inventing an ALK-class claim merely to negate it would not create a valuable negative finding.
strongest_alternative: Unknown exact exposure/control/readout, formulation/salt/enantiomer effects, curve construction and off-target pharmacology can explain differences; observed screen salt discordance reinforces unresolved compatibility rather than proving formulation biology.
interpretation_limits: No class sensitivity, ALK dependency, target engagement, stable formulation phenotype, cross-model pooled potency, clinical efficacy or therapeutic window. One model and technical source SD do not establish donor uncertainty.
follow_through: Automatic interpretation reassessment after literal measurements found compound/formulation ambiguity and unchanged primary-art choice. Exact crosswalk checked, all six conditions/four dose summaries retained, no favorable subset picked. Additional numerical plots or target searches do not repair missing use.
reopen: A real published unresolved claim plus matched exposure/control/endpoint and additional authenticated native condition comparison could change a defined validation experiment. All relevant suitable pending evidence must be resolved. No new source search/exhaustion assertion follows from this finite failure.
